avis.titre: Does not irritate sensitive skin plus amazingly fast results.
avis.texte: Update: This product deserves the 5 stars. I began using this in late March 2026. It is now mid-late June 2026 and I can confidently say that this is giving me the benefits of retinal without any of the side effects I normally experience. My skin is clearer, brighter, softer, and just looks very healthy. Results are subtle and gradual over time. I can confidently say that this product works and I don’t know what kind of Hoodoo they put in here to make it so gentle but has not caused a single blemish, no rosacea flares while using this, and my skin looks and feels great. I’m an Aveda grad, I know quality skin care and you absolutely don’t have to pay enormous amounts of money. OTC retinol products are mostly all within the same range of strengths (either mild or moderate). There’s simply no reason to spend $100 on a serum when you can purchase a lower cost serum that offers the same results. One note here about retinol vs retinal(this product contains retinal vs retinol: retinal is a form of retinol that is biologically closer to retinoic acid. Retinoic acid is the only form your skin can use and OTC products require your skin to do the conversion. Some of the strength is lost during this conversion process. Retinoic acid is not available as a OTC product. It requires a prescription because it is much stronger. Basically retinol needs 2 conversions in your skin to create retinoic acid. Like this: 2 steps: retinol → retinal → retinoic acid. Retinal is 11 times closer to retinoi

I started using this Retinal Skin Booster Serum on July 18 after my skin was badly damaged by hormonal changes caused by perimenopause. The damage happened in just a few days and honestly felt permanent. Before trying this cream, I had already used several other products without seeing any improvement. After reading so many positive reviews, I decided to give this one a chance. At first, I applied it only once a day to the affected area. I didn't notice any changes during the first few days, so I started using it twice a day. Every night after my shower, I applied it directly to the affected area. Every morning, I mixed a small amount with my regular body cream and applied it again. I followed this routine consistently without skipping a day. Today, my skin is completely healthy again, and I couldn't be happier with the results. This cream has been amazing for me. I highly recommend it. My advice is to be patient. You may not see immediate results, but give it time and stay consistent. For me, it was absolutely worth it.

Ich finde dieses Serum wirklich gelungen. Besonders interessant ist für mich das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis: 150 ml im Pumpspender machen es zu einem sehr günstigen All-over-Retinal-Serum aus Korea, das man nicht nur im Gesicht, sondern auch großzügig an Hals, Dekolleté und Körper verwenden kann. Die wichtigste Information musste ich allerdings erst recherchieren: Das Serum enthält 0,01 % Retinal (100 ppm). Schade, dass die Konzentration nicht deutlicher angegeben wird. 0,01 % klingt zunächst wenig, hat für mich aber absolut seine Berechtigung. Gerade für Retinoid-Einsteiger, empfindliche Haut sowie Hals und Dekolleté finde ich eine niedrigere Konzentration sinnvoll. Bei Retinoiden ist mehr nicht automatisch besser – entscheidend ist schließlich auch, dass die Haut das Produkt verträgt und man es regelmäßig verwenden kann. Auch die restliche Formulierung gefällt mir sehr gut. Niacinamid steht relativ weit vorne in der INCI-Liste. Eine genaue Konzentration konnte ich allerdings nicht finden und möchte deshalb keine Prozentzahl behaupten. Dazu kommen Centella asiatica und verschiedene Centella-Bestandteile, außerdem unter anderem Beta-Glucan, Panthenol, Ceramide NP, Cholesterin und Vitamin E. Das finde ich als Begleitung zu einem Retinoid sehr schön. Besonders hervorheben möchte ich Glycerin. Dieser hervorragende Feuchtigkeitsspender wird meiner Meinung nach völlig unterschätzt und muss sich hinter der wesentlich stärker vermarkteten Hyaluronsäure keineswegs verstecken. Die Tex

I’ve been using this retinal skin booster for a few weeks now and I’m honestly impressed, especially for the price and size. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, which makes it easy to layer with the rest of my skincare. Since starting, my skin feels smoother and looks a bit brighter overall. I like that it includes soothing ingredients as well, because I didn’t experience much irritation—just a little dryness in the beginning, which is expected with retinal. It feels gentle enough for regular use if you build up slowly. That said, if you’re used to stronger retinoids, this might feel a bit mild and results may take longer to show. But for beginners or anyone with sensitive skin, it’s a great starting point. Overall, a solid, budget-friendly option for improving skin texture and adding a gentle anti-aging step to your routine. I would definitely repurchase.
